rows.name: Tracking
rows.note: The mug and the coffee machine rendered at each tracker's pose over the faded video, frame by frame. Mask IoU of the mug: the paper's tracking table.

gt.label: Real
gt.cap: The human video. The mug is carried from the table to the machine's tray.

prior.label: RSRD
prior.cap: RSRD, re-implemented. Its mug is far too large and in the wrong pose from the first frame, and it never sits on the tray.

ours.label: R2Sem2R
ours.cap: Our track. The rendered mug stays on the real one through the grasp, the carry and the placement.

rows.name: Grasp
rows.note: The gripper is yellow where it intersects the mug and green where the grasp is free of collision.

gt.label: Real
gt.cap: The demonstrator's grasp. Thumb and index finger close on the handle.

prior.label: Prior
prior.alt: A yellow robot gripper intersecting the body of the mug.
prior.cap: A prior grasp collides with the mug instead of taking its handle.

ours.label: R2Sem2R
ours.alt: A green robot gripper closing on the handle of the mug.
ours.cap: Our grasp closes on the handle, as the human did.

rows.name: Mesh
rows.note: The same robot camera view, real and simulated.

gt.label: Real
gt.alt: The real xArm7 camera view of the black coffee machine and a white mug.
gt.cap: The real robot camera with the coffee machine and the mug.

prior.label: Prior
prior.alt: A simulated scene with a blotchy gray coffee machine mesh.
prior.cap: A prior mesh of the machine renders blotchy and gray.

ours.label: R2Sem2R
ours.alt: A simulated scene with a clean black coffee machine.
